question.question: Compare target selection for Venom, Hypnosis, Pilfering 1/2 and Constriction, including which Hypnosis slots may be used and how many Constriction tokens each target gets.

fixed_key_unchanged.expected_answer: Venom affects every eligible zoo with strictly higher appeal than yours. Hypnosis affects the eligible zoo with highest appeal (no effect if yourself), and may perform its action only from slot 1, 2 or 3. Pilfering 1 affects the highest-appeal zoo; Pilfering 2 affects the highest-appeal zoo and the zoo with most conservation, applying each target separately (twice if the same zoo qualifies for both); a self target has no effect. Constriction affects all eligible zoos ahead of yours on appeal and/or conservation; each gets 1 token if ahead on 1 track, or 2 tokens if ahead on both. Normal eligibility of at least 5 appeal and tie-selection rules still apply.
fixed_key_unchanged.source_references: Accepted official base Icon Overview p2 interactive ability panels; Glossary pp2–3; FAQ p1

venom.primary: Icon Overview p2 Venom: Affected: All zoos with a higher appeal value than yours. Glossary p3: Only players whose zoos have at least 5 appeal can be affected.

hypnosis.primary: Icon Overview p2 Hypnosis: Affected: Zoo with the highest appeal. If your zoo, no effect. Perform 1 action from card slot 1, 2, or 3 of the affected player. Glossary p2: Only a player whose zoo has at least 5 appeal can be affected by hypnosis. If there are several zoos with the highest appeal, you may choose which player is affected. If you are the affected player, the ability has no effect.

pilfering.primary: Icon Overview p2 Pilfering: Affected: X = 1: Zoo with the highest appeal. X= 2: Zoo with highest appeal and zoo with most conservation points. In both cases: If your zoo, no effect. Glossary p3: Only players whose zoos have at least 5 appeal can be affected. If there are several zoos with the highest appeal or the most conservation points, you may choose the affected player. To have the most conservation points, a player has to have at least 1 conservation point. If you are the affected player, the ability has no effect. If you are allowed to pilfer twice from the same player, those pilferings take place one after the other. Raw official FAQ p1 repeats the conservation tie and at-least-one rules.

constriction.primary: Icon Overview p2 Constriction: Affected: All zoos ahead of yours on the Appeal and / or Conservation track. Place 1 Constriction token each on the first X Action cards from the right (highest X card slots, where X = number of tracks on which they’re ahead). Glossary p2: Only players whose zoos have at least 5 appeal can be affected by Constriction (no matter whether they would gain the Constriction token for appeal and/or conservation). If resolving Constriction 1, place a token on the card in slot 5. If resolving Constriction 2, place tokens on the cards in slots 4 and 5.

scope_reasoning: The literal request expressly asks target selection for all four abilities, plus allowed Hypnosis slots and per-target Constriction counts. Eligibility, tied-leader choice, multiplicity, and whether selecting oneself actually affects a zoo belong to target selection. Self no-effect is required on this reading because it determines affected targets and prevents treating oneself as an ordinary victim or automatically selecting the next opponent. It is not demanded merely because the fixed key mentions it. By contrast the concrete consequences of pilfering, copied-card side, venom fees, and token cleanup are outside the requested comparison.

accepted: Eligible highest-appeal zoo imports normal eligibility for that noun phrase; no numeric repetition required.
Pilfering 2 separately targets A and B entails two independently resolved selections, including repeated selection if A=B. Response a need not expressly say twice.
One token on each of slots 4 and 5 entails two. Response b tokens on its slot-4 and slot-5 cards uses ordinary distributed placement and conveys the same count.
Copy slots 1–3 is accepted shorthand for performing an action from the affected player card in one of those slots.
not_inferred: In a, an eligible highest-appeal zoo and a most-conservation zoo with at least 1 conservation does not explicitly carry eligible across the repeated indefinite article to the second target. No global sentence in that response supplies a five-appeal eligibility rule for every interactive target.
Naming Hypnosis or Pilfering in b does not itself state the missing self-target treatment. Those labels cannot substitute for all requested distinctions.
The evidence strings name source topics; neither quotes or states the missing factual rule.
ordinary_shorthand_analysis.boundary_note: Response a conservation-floor omission is a scope/grammar judgment, not a finding that any expressed rule is false. An interpretation distributing eligible over the coordinated targets would make a correct; under the ordinary local noun-phrase reading used here it remains partial.

original_response.answer: 1. Venom affects every other zoo with higher appeal than yours, provided each has at least 5 appeal; you are never a target. 2. Hypnosis targets an eligible highest-appeal zoo, with the actor choosing among ties; it has no effect if the actor is the target and may copy only slots 1, 2, or 3. 3. Pilfering 1 targets an eligible highest-appeal zoo; Pilfering 2 separately targets an eligible highest-appeal zoo and a most-conservation zoo with at least 1 conservation. The actor chooses tied leaders for each selection; self-target has no effect. 4. Constriction affects every other zoo with at least 5 appeal that is ahead on appeal and/or conservation. Ahead on one track gets one token on that target’s slot-5 card; ahead on both gets one token on each of its slot-4 and slot-5 cards.
